snippet.title: ADRIFT Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: September 2025
snippet.description:
Drift away in the serenity of the desert. Carry your fragile cargo across a top-down world, and discover fragments from a time before. Untwine labyrinthian roads, where sweeping dunes make way for twisting canyons, and find oases in which to plan. Where will your journey take you?

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2903570/ADRIFT/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.

Love indie games? Subscribe and hit the bell!

Six One Indie is a grassroots collective focused on making gaming showcases, awards, and overall visibility more approachable for independent developers.
